# Wilmington and Beaches

> > Official tourism guide for Wilmington, NC and the Cape Fear Coast beaches including Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, and Kure Beach.

Managed by the New Hanover County Tourism Development Authority (Wilmington and Beaches CVB), this site provides comprehensive visitor information for coastal North Carolina's Cape Fear River region, including events, accommodations, dining, history, and outdoor activities along the Atlantic Ocean and Intracoastal Waterway.

## Key Topics

- Wilmington NC
- Wrightsville Beach
- Carolina Beach
- Kure Beach
- Cape Fear River
- Intracoastal Waterway
- Atlantic Ocean beaches
- Coastal tourism
- Beach vacation planning
- Historic downtown Wilmington
- Cameron Art Museum
- National Register Historic District
- Live music and concerts
- Family activities
- North Carolina Azalea Festival

## Visitor Planning & Information

- [Visit Wilmington & Beaches | Things To Do, Hotels & Restaurants](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com): Homepage for Wilmington & Beaches tourism: hotels, restaurants, activities
- [Plan a family vacation & find things to do in Wilmington, NC](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/about/news-and-accolades/articles-and-coverage/coast-goes-beyond-the-beach): Family vacation planning guide for Wilmington NC beaches and activities
- [Marinas in Wilmington NC, Wrightsville, Carolina, & Kure Beaches](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/about/getting-around/marinas): Marina directory for Wilmington area beaches and Intracoastal Waterway
- [Wilmington NC Beaches E-News, Trip Ideas, & Annual Events](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/about/especial-signup): Newsletter signup for Wilmington & Beaches seasonal events and trip ideas

## Area Information & History

- [History of Wilmington | From the Colonial Era to Today](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/about/area-information/historical-overview): Historical overview of Wilmington from colonial era to present day

## What's Happening & New Attractions

- [What's New in Wilmington for 2025](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/blog/post/whats-new-in-wilmington): 2025 new attractions, restaurants, museums in Wilmington & Cargo District
- [Free & Affordable Activities in Wilmington, NC](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/blog/post/free-and-affordable-activities-in-wilmington-nc): Budget-friendly activities: Riverwalk, trails, museums, filming locations

## Festivals & Annual Events

- [Much Ado about Spring: North Carolina Azalea Festival Salutes the Season](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/articles/post/much-ado-about-spring-north-carolina-azalea-festival-salutes-the-season): NC Azalea Festival spring celebration with parade and garden tours
- [Guide to Kure Beach's Cape Fear Kite Festival](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/blog/post/guide-to-kure-beachs-cape-fear-kite-festival): Cape Fear Kite Festival guide at Kure Beach with family activities
- [Holiday Traditions in Wilmington, NC | Christmas Flotilla](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/blog/post/a-twist-on-holiday-traditions-in-wilmington): Christmas holiday traditions guide: flotilla, lights, historic tours

- [Seaside Soccer Classic & Beach Wrestling National Championships Returns this Weekend](https://www.wilmingtonandbeaches.com/articles/post/seaside-soccer-classic-beach-wrestling-national-championships-returns-this-weekend): Seaside Soccer Classic & Beach Wrestling Championships in Wilmington area
